known_metric_issues: C3.breathe measures TOTAL band-amplitude variability, which the broadband floor dominates; it reports 0.352 with AR(1) modulation ON and 0.394 with it OFF -- backwards. Must be recomputed on the excised tone-only series to isolate the modulation layer it was written to test.
C2.exists white level (178-198 Hz) is segment-sensitive: 6.45 vs 94.45 on two spans of the same Day20.8 recording. Upper bound is warn-only until a robust white-level estimator exists.
C3.width real max is 8.46 against a 9.0 bound -- only ~6% headroom, and it does not catch current v3 (7.96).
